content:textarea:2:19.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:2:19.html: The Salvation Army Red Shield Youth Centers of Tulsa Metropolitan area provide a safe and nurturing environment for young people to succeed academically, develop good character and leadership skills, engage in healthy activities, and find spiritual guidance. These clubs offer programs such as tutoring, sports, arts, and character-building activities to encourage personal growth.
content:textarea:2:19.content: The Salvation Army Red Shield Youth Centers of Tulsa Metropolitan area provide a safe and nurturing environment for young people to succeed academically, develop good character and leadership skills, engage in healthy activities, and find spiritual guidance. These clubs offer programs such as tutoring, sports, arts, and character-building activities to encourage personal growth.

content:textarea:3:63.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:3:63.html: Through a holistic approach that incorporates faith-based values, the clubs help young people find purpose and meaning in their lives, and offer love and acceptance to all. The goal is to help kids and adults build better futures, whether through academic achievement, athletic success, artistic expression, or personal growth.

content:textarea:8:94.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:8:94.html: The Salvation Army Red Shield Youth Centers offers a range of programs for youth, including seasonal camps, sports such as volleyball and flag football, swimming lessons, and after-school programs. These programs provide a safe and fun environment where children can learn new skills, make friends, and build confidence and self-esteem. The camps and sports programs teach important life skills like teamwork and sportsmanship, while the after-school programs promote academic success and personal development.

The camps and sports programs teach important life skills like teamwork and sportsmanship, while the after-school programs promote academic success and personal development.

content:textarea:9:23.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:9:23.html: If you're interested in learning more about the Red Shield Youth Centers and the programs we offer, contact the Youth Center nearest to you to get more information about specific programs, schedules, and availability.

content:wysiwyg_basic:14:67.html:
After School Program

The Red Shield Youth Centers provide a safe and nurturing environment for kids who need a place to land after school.

Learn More

Summer Day Camp

When the school year ends, many parents rely on the Red Shield Youth Centers to provide the care and supervision throughout the work week.

Learn More

Heart O Hills (Overnight Camp)

Located just outside of Tahlequah, Oklahoma, Camp Heart O Hills provides the camping adventure of a lifetime.

Learn More

Youth Basketball

The Red Shield Youth Center hosts youth basketball leagues for children of all ages.

Learn More

Youth Girl's Volleyball

Youth Girl's Volleyball leagues are available at the Red Shield Youth Centers, encouraging a spirit of competition in a safe setting.

Learn More

Youth Flag Football

Competitive Youth Flag Football leagues are a great option for kids who are looking to keep active throughout the year.

Learn More

Youth Swimming Programs

From open swimming sessions, to group swim lessons, the Red Shield Youth Center is a great place to cool off in the summer.

Learn More

Adult Water Aerobics

For adults looking for a fun way to remain active and stay fit, the Red Shield Youth Center facility offers Adult Water Aerobics.

Learn More

content:text:18:14.html: Homework Assistance and Counseling

content:textarea:19:40.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:19:40.html: The Salvation Army Red Shield Youth Centers serve children and youth of all ages, up to 18 years old. We provide one-on-one assistance with homework and school assignments, as well as the teaching and advancement of literacy and study skills.
content:textarea:19:40.content: The Salvation Army Red Shield Youth Centers serve children and youth of all ages, up to 18 years old. We provide one-on-one assistance with homework and school assignments, as well as the teaching and advancement of literacy and study skills.

content:textarea:20:69.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:20:69.html: Many of our facilities also include computer labs to help children with their homework.
content:textarea:20:69.content: Many of our facilities also include computer labs to help children with their homework.

content:text:21:41.name: Heading
content:text:21:41.html: Sports, Clubs, and Extracurricular Activities

content:textarea:22:22.name: Paragraph
content:textarea:22:22.html: Healthy minds and healthy bodies are both crucial elements of youth development. Our low-cost programs offer children from low-income neighborhoods a chance to play sports, learn athletic skills, and cultivate healthy, safe relationships with friends through better social skills.

content:text:25:92.html: Art and Music Programs

content:textarea:26:66.html: Our youth community programs enable children to experience music and art education in positive, safe environments. Our wide array of classes focuses on everything from choir, band, and dancing to drawing, photography, writing, and acting.
